newsitem.title: USA: China Tire stake raised by HK-based group.
newsitem.headline: China Tire stake raised by HK-based group.

text.p: A group including China Strategic Holdings Ltd said Friday it raised its stake in China Tire Holdings Ltd to 8.3 percent, or 506,500 common shares.

In a filing with the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission, the group said it bought 93,000 additional shares in China Tire between December 12 and 30, at prices ranging from $9 to $9.50 a share. Shares were unchanged at 9-1/8 on Friday.
The group previously held 413,500 shares, or 6.89 percent of the common stock outstanding.
The group also holds three million shares, or 100 percent, of China Tire's supervoting common stock. Each share is convertible into one common share.
China Tire and China Strategic are both based in Hong Kong. China Strategic is controlled by Singaporean investor Oei Hong Leon, the firm's chairman and chief executive.
